KPI-01.name: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
KPI-01.business_definition: Total gross food catalog value of non-cancelled orders.
KPI-01.sql_equivalent: SELECT SUM(order_amount) AS gmv FROM orders_table WHERE order_status != 'Cancelled';
KPI-01.notes: Verified exactly against delivered order food amounts.

KPI-02.name: Net Revenue (Platform Inflow)
KPI-02.business_definition: Total gross customer cash inflow collected on successfully delivered orders.
KPI-02.sql_equivalent: SELECT SUM(final_amount) AS net_revenue FROM orders_table WHERE order_status = 'Delivered';
KPI-02.notes: Includes food price + delivery fee - discounts. Governed by platform minimum order payment floor: final_amount = max(50.00, order_amount + delivery_fee - discount_amount). Exactly 67 orders (65 delivered, 2 cancelled) invoke the floor constraint where linear formula falls below ₹50.00 (aggregate floor adjustment: +₹911.00 total, +₹876.00 delivered).

KPI-03.name: Average Order Value (Net AOV)
KPI-03.business_definition: Average customer cash outflow per successfully completed delivery.
KPI-03.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(AVG(final_amount), 2) AS net_aov FROM orders_table WHERE order_status = 'Delivered';
KPI-03.notes: Net AOV = ₹967.33. Gross AOV (GMV / Completed Orders) = ₹970.75.

KPI-04.name: Take Rate
KPI-04.business_definition: Effective percentage of GMV retained by the platform as restaurant commissions.
KPI-04.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.order_amount * r.commission_percentage / 100.0) / SUM(o.order_amount), 2) FROM orders_table o JOIN restaurants r ON o.restaurant_id=r.restaurant_id WHERE o.order_status='Delivered';
KPI-04.notes: Calculated on delivered GMV and realized restaurant commissions.

KPI-05.name: Total Orders Placed
KPI-05.business_definition: Total volume of order requests initiated across the ecosystem.
KPI-05.sql_equivalent: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders_table;

KPI-06.name: Completed Orders
KPI-06.business_definition: Volume of orders successfully fulfilled and delivered to customers.
KPI-06.sql_equivalent: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders_table WHERE order_status = 'Delivered';
KPI-06.notes: Fulfillment rate is 96.04% of total placed orders.

KPI-07.name: Cancellation Rate
KPI-07.business_definition: Proportion of placed orders that were cancelled prior to fulfillment.
KPI-07.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status='Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders_table;

KPI-08.name: Delivery SLA Breach Rate
KPI-08.business_definition: Proportion of deliveries exceeding the 45-minute operational SLA threshold.
KPI-08.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_duration > 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM deliveries;
KPI-08.dax_equivalent: SLA Breach Rate = DIVIDE(CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(deliveries), deliveries[delivery_duration] > 45), COUNTROWS(deliveries), 0) * 100

KPI-09.name: Average Delivery Time
KPI-09.business_definition: Mean transit and fulfillment duration from order placement to delivery.
KPI-09.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(AVG(delivery_duration), 2) AS avg_duration FROM deliveries;

KPI-10.name: Delivered Orders per Active Rider
KPI-10.business_definition: Fleet fulfillment throughput: Total deliveries divided by registered active riders.
KPI-10.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(d.delivery_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.rider_id), 2) FROM riders r LEFT JOIN deliveries d ON r.rider_id=d.rider_id;
KPI-10.notes: Fleet average is 12.49 total deliveries/rider (12.00 completed). Renamed from 'Rider Utilization' because shift hours and idle time capacity are not tracked in fleet table.

KPI-11.name: Average Revenue per Registered Restaurant
KPI-11.business_definition: Average customer transaction inflow generated per contracted merchant partner account.
KPI-11.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.final_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.restaurant_id), 2) FROM restaurants r LEFT JOIN orders_table o ON r.restaurant_id=o.restaurant_id WHERE o.order_status='Delivered';
KPI-11.dax_equivalent: Avg Revenue Per Restaurant = DIVIDE([Net Revenue], DISTINCTCOUNT(restaurants[restaurant_id]), 0)
KPI-11.notes: Gross customer inflow per registered restaurant (N=1,500): ₹30950.66. Active-partner inflow across restaurants with >= 1 order (N=1,499): ₹30971.31 (dormant partner R00369 Mandal Ltd has 0 orders). Gross food GMV per restaurant: ₹31060.08. Net restaurant food payout (post-commission): ₹24076.57. Average completed orders per registered restaurant: 32.0.

KPI-12.name: Contribution Margin Percentage
KPI-12.business_definition: Realized platform operating margin on completed orders post-rider fulfillment costs.
KPI-12.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(estimated_profit) / SUM(final_amount), 2) FROM vw_unit_economics WHERE order_status='Delivered';
KPI-12.notes: Realized Margin on Delivered Orders = 23.59%. Gross Booking Margin across All Orders = 23.60%.

KPI-13.name: Total Estimated Operating Profit
KPI-13.business_definition: Platform realized operating profit: Commission Revenue + Delivery Fee - Delivery Cost (₹30 baseline).
KPI-13.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(SUM(estimated_profit), 2) FROM vw_unit_economics WHERE order_status = 'Delivered';
KPI-13.notes: Realized profit on Delivered orders = ₹10,953,031.58. Gross booking profit across All orders = ₹11,393,907.16.

KPI-14.name: Customer Repeat-Purchase Rate
KPI-14.business_definition: Proportion of registered customers who placed more than one order across the platform lifetime.
KPI-14.sql_equivalent: WITH o AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders_table GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN c>1 THEN 1 END)/COUNT(*), 2) FROM o;
KPI-14.notes: 4,997 customers with repeat orders out of 5,000 (99.94%). Strictly distinct from Transaction Repeat Order Share (89.99% = 43,197 repeat-origin delivered orders / 47,994 delivered orders) and cohort retention.

KPI-15.name: Cohort Retention Rate (Month 1 Average)
KPI-15.business_definition: Average percentage of an acquisition cohort returning to order in Month 1, anchored on First Order Month.
KPI-15.mathematical_formula: AVG(Active Users in Month 1 / Month 0 Base) * 100
KPI-15.filters: Valid monthly acquisition cohorts based on first non-cancelled order
KPI-15.dax_equivalent: Month 1 Retention = DIVIDE([Active Month 1 Cohort], [Cohort Base], 0) * 100
KPI-15.notes: First-order acquisition cohort methodology resolves pre-signup order data anomalies.

KPI-16.name: Historical Realized Spend per Customer (Cumulative ARPU)
KPI-16.business_definition: Average cumulative net customer expenditure generated per registered user across the observed timeline.
KPI-16.sql_equivalent: SELECT ROUND(SUM(final_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) FROM orders_table WHERE order_status='Delivered';
KPI-16.notes: Historical realized spend per customer is ₹9285.20 (Delivered) and ₹9656.33 (All orders). Renamed from 'Customer Lifetime Value' because true predictive CLV requires churn-hazard modeling and future cash-flow discount rates.
